title: Build expected goals
outcome: Train logistic regression to estimate expected goals: the scoring probability of a shot.

blocks.body: Question: Which shots turn into goals?
Mathematics: Learn distance and angle geometry, sigmoid, log likelihood, regularization, and probability calibration.
Dataset: StatsBomb Open Data: events/{match_id}.json joined to match dates. For shots, use shot locations and outcomes. Split by whole match and date.
Reading: ISL chapters 4 and 6. Keep vendor expected-goals estimates out of the training features.

blocks.title: StatsBomb Open Data
blocks.note: Use the README, competition list, match files, event schema, and attribution terms. Select a historical competition with enough matches.

blocks.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning · Python
blocks.note: Use selected chapters and Python labs. The book PDF is free on the authors’ site.

blocks.body: Challenge: Explain why shot outcome is a target and provider expected-goals values are excluded from your input features.

tasks.prompt: Extract shots and outcomes. Compute distance and angle to goal from pitch coordinates.
